rows.grounds: object of the imperative; the immortal essence to be heard
compound describing the nectar as the true nature of Kaula
compound qualifying the nectar as consisting of kāmakalā

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the Kaula nectar the listener is commanded to hear?
premises: A nectar is presented as the object to be heard.
This nectar is identified as the true essence of Kaula.
This nectar is characterized as having the nature of kāmakalā.
items.inference: The Kaula nectar to be heard is the true Kaula essence whose nature is kāmakalā.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true essence of Kaula, whose nature is kāmakalā.
